findings: The sole answer_fresh_address caller first restricts qtype to A/AAAA, then obtains the ID through single_fresh_address_with_hint. Its eligibility method requires positive_address(kind).is_some(), live generation/hint identity and nonstale/unexpired data.

Selection only unlinks/relinks LRU slot links, preserving entry details and generation. The call immediately borrows Cache immutably; no intervening cache mutation or callback can invalidate the selected data.

EntryDetails::new copies only positive, correctly sized A/AAAA Record bytes into [u8;4]/[u8;16]; Record is immutable after insertion. The getter therefore yields the same bytes and length as the former Arc<Record>.data read for every eligible caller.

The existing fallback writer already uses the same kind choice and positive_address(...).expect invariant. Warm-path length/capacity/limit checks, packet bytes, TTL, logging fallback, take/resize and buffer ownership remain byte-identical.
